intro: One plate of nasi dagang has an estimated 600 kcal. Most of the calories come from the rice cooked with santan and the gulai gravy.

variants.name: Nasi dagang with extra boiled egg

diet: Yes, but nasi dagang is a calorie-dense breakfast. One plate is almost the same as a normal lunch. If you have it in the morning, choose a lighter lunch. The ikan tongkol gives good protein too.
tips: Ask for half rice or a bit less.
Choose gulai ikan, not ayam, and take less gravy.
Add more acar timun for freshness and volume.

swap.name: Nasi dagang half rice with fish and extra acar
swap.why: You still get the nasi dagang taste, but save about 150 kcal.

faq.q: Which state is nasi dagang from?
faq.a: Nasi dagang is famous in Terengganu and Kelantan. It's usually eaten for breakfast.

faq.q: Why does nasi dagang have halba?
faq.a: Halba (fenugreek) gives the rice its special aroma. Glutinous rice and normal rice are mixed so the texture is softer.

faq.q: What's the difference between Terengganu and Kelantan nasi dagang?
faq.a: The Terengganu version uses white rice mixed with glutinous rice, while the Kelantan version often uses red rice. Both usually come with gulai ikan tongkol as the main lauk.
